identity: Whitebridge sells the same river basket twice while poachers, wolves and wetland collectors each claim a toll.

quests.title: Sold Twice, Delivered Never
quests.text: Basket-Poacher Thorn has found a way to sell every river basket twice, and somehow neither buyer gets supper. His Unlicensed Poachers trade after nightfall in the {name:oakwood} {dir_of:r20_anchor_016:oakwood}; defeat five of them there at night. I have spent years earning this market's good name, and I will not let him sell that twice as well.
quests.lesson: A night outlaw roster in a forest kind.

quests.title: The Pack at the Back Door
quests.text: I sent the carts around Thorn's buyers, only to hear that Briarpack Wolves hunt the {name:meadows} {zone_area:meadows} at night. Defeat five there after dark so our drivers have a fighting chance. Hurt one and the pack comes running; work from the edge, with room to retreat.
quests.lesson: Pack calls: pull from the edge.

quests.title: Thorn's Double Sale
quests.text: {name:basket_poacher_thorn} does his business in the {name:willowbanks} {dir_from_giver:basket_poacher_thorn}, day and night; apparently a man who sells everything twice needs the extra hours. Defeat him and report back to me. Ansel's kitchen paid for those baskets in good faith, and I mean to honour the order.
quests.lesson: Named normal leader on his own: a fixed, memorable fight.

quests.title: The Other End of the River Trade
quests.text: Thorn's accounts name Elven buyers too, and an Accord trading partner deserves to hear when somebody is spending her coin. Find Ilwen Petalmeasure at Lorindor Berrycourt in Lorindor and tell her what happened here. This is one of three journeys I can offer you, with more work likely at the other end. Give her my regards before you mention the baskets.

quests.title: A Ledger for the Dwarves
quests.text: Some of Thorn's baskets were sold as Dwarven freight; I expect the buyers will have quite precise objections to his arithmetic. Visit Dorrin Gateledger in Dur Brannoc and explain the double sales. Of the three journeys I can offer, this one takes you to our Dwarven allies. Be clear about which merchant you mean when you say he cheated them.

quests.title: Cold Storage
quests.text: Thorn's accounts reach as far as Tarnwatch Fold in Frostbarrow Shelf, which is an impressive distance for a basket nobody has received. Find Edda Tarnmantle there and tell her about his double sales. This is the coldest of the three journeys I can offer you. Pack warmly; I would like our explanation to arrive with all its fingers.

quests.title: A Measure That Stays Put
quests.text: My surveying brace shifted in the rain, and for one alarming moment my measurements gave the river a new address. Bring me six planks of any wood and six Steel Bars here at Bridgechalk Dig. Alloy iron with coal to make the steel, whenever your other work leaves time. I need the brace to stay put long enough to trust the next reading.

quests.title: Optional: Bears in the Stores
quests.text: Bramble Bears from the {name:briarwood} {dir_of:r20_anchor_062:briarwood} keep raiding our stores, and one of them has developed a taste for chalk-dusted biscuits. Bring down five by day. After dark the Briar-Web Spiders take that wood, and you are welcome to leave them to it.
quests.lesson: Optional: heavy daytime animals; the wood changes owner at night.

quests.title: A Survey for the Heights
quests.text: Borin Splitbolt needs our survey work before he can plan supplies through Stormvault Heights. Visit him at Splitbolt Station there and pass on my findings. Reach level 30 before you set out into that contested country. The Accord needs people who can bring a sound plan home as well as carry one out.

quests.title: The Basket Toll
quests.text: Toll Mirefolk at the {name:ferry_camp} {dir_from_giver:ferry_camp} demand payment for every river basket, and Murk calls the whole business a ferry service. Defeat five of them, by day or night. They rush to help one another inside the camp, so fight from its edge. I can mend a cart, but I cannot keep mending our accounts after every crossing.
quests.lesson: A swarm camp: fight at the edge.

quests.title: Optional: The Siltbasket Toll
quests.text: Before Murk built his ferry business, his relatives set up the {name:siltbasket} {dir_from_giver:siltbasket}, and they still charge carters for the privilege of being robbed. Defeat six Toll Mirefolk there, by day or night. Fight from the edge of the camp; they rush to help each other.
quests.lesson: Optional: a smaller swarm camp in the lower shire.

quests.title: Murk's Final Fare
quests.text: {name:ferryman_murk} runs the {name:ferry_camp} {dir_from_giver:ferryman_murk}, charging whatever he thinks a frightened carter will pay. Defeat him; he is there by day and night. There will always be thieves along the river, but this one ought to learn that honest trade has defenders too.
quests.lesson: Named normal leader at the camp centre.

quests.title: Bounty: Briar-Web Spiders
quests.text: The Briar-Web Spiders have strung the {name:thornwood} {zone_area:thornwood} with enough web to wrap a wagon. Kill six there after dark and report back for your bounty. I can offer the job again twenty-five minutes after you turn it in; bring yourself back, and leave the spiders where they fall.
